hypothesis: westack-review takes diff, branch, PR, plan-document and PR-comment requests, and leaves acceptance audits, debugging, security audits, UI critique, planning, shipping and explicitly named competitors (gstack review and plan-*-review, code-review, pr-review-toolkit) to their owners. A request for a CodeRabbit review goes to westack-review, which hands the CLI call over only after consent (core defer entry review-coderabbit-cli; task cases vendor-consent and vendor-declined).
preparation: population.json is machine-specific and not shipped. Snapshot it into a copy of this folder before registering: python skills/westack-eval/scripts/route.py population --registry --root <westack repo>/skills --plugin superpowers=<superpowers plugin skills folder> --out population.json. Expectations name skills in the user's 2026-10-28 population (gstack review, plan-ceo-review, plan-eng-review, cso, design-review, ship, superpowers:writing-plans, westack-verify, westack-debug). A built-in or plugin command that is not a SKILL.md folder (/code-review, pr-review-toolkit) cannot be in the population, so those near misses expect NONE: any population skill chosen is a misroute. r23 (added 2026-10-30): the CodeRabbit plugin 1.1.1 is installed on the user's machine, so a fresh population holds coderabbit:code-review; keep it in. Its own description triggers on review requests, so it is r23's likeliest misroute: picking it skips westack's consent step. For host routing set backend.name to host.
